description: Database migration fails due to data or schema conflicts

diagnostic_steps.rationale: PostgreSQL errors are specific and tell exact problem
Shows which migrations have run vs pending
Understand what schema change is being attempted

common_bugs.symptom: operator class 'varchar_pattern_ops' does not accept data type uuid
common_bugs.cause: Changing CharField to UUIDField but index exists with varchar operator

common_bugs.symptom: invalid input syntax for type uuid: 'UNKNOWN'
common_bugs.cause: Existing data contains non-UUID values being cast to UUID

common_bugs.symptom: It is impossible to add a non-nullable field without a default
common_bugs.cause: Adding required field to existing table with data
common_bugs.fix: Either: 1) Add default='' to field, or 2) Use null=True initially, then fill data, then remove null

common_bugs.cause: Two apps reference each other's models in migrations
common_bugs.fix: Use string references: ForeignKey('other_app.Model') instead of importing

fix_order: Always: 1) Fix/clean data with RunPython, 2) Then apply schema change with AlterField
